d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how Uganda’s military chief, General Muhoozi Kainerugaba, has ignited fresh political turmoil with a 10-year jail threat against media outlets and journalists accused of insulting or belittling President Yoweri Museveni and senior figures. Returning to X after a hiatus, Muhoozi warned of harsh prison penalties, floated plans for a new policy regulating foreign media in Uganda, and cautioned that foreign media agents could face the Court Martial.
